'''International relations'''
*[[South Africa v. Israel (Genocide Convention)|''South Africa v. Israel'']], [[Allegations of genocide in the 2023 Israeli attack on Gaza]]
**The [[International Court of Justice]] rules that some allegations of [[Israel]] committing [[genocide]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] are "plausible" and orders Israel to take measures to prevent and punish acts of genocide, to protect [[Palestinians]], and to [[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip|allow in humanitarian aid]]. However, Israel is not required to end its [[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|military operation]]. [https://www.jta.org/2024/01/26/politics/international-court-of-justice-rules-that-some-allegations-of-israel-committing-genocide-are-plausible  (''Jewish Telegraphic Agency'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/01/26/world/israel-hamas-gaza-news (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2024/jan/26/middle-east-crisis-live-updates-icj-genocide-case-ruling-israel-hamas-gaza-hostage-talks-cia#maincontent (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1974 Mitsubishi Heavy Industries bombing]]
**Police in Japan announce they have arrested who they believe to be Satoshi Kirishima, a member of the [[East Asia Anti-Japan Armed Front]] who has been a fugitive from justice for 50 years for his role in a series of bombings of companies. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2024/01/26/japan/crime-legal/fugitive-radical-caught/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Justice Department]] finds former [[New York (state)|New York]] [[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] liable for sexual harassment. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/26/nyregion/andrew-cuomo-justice-department-harassment.html (''The New York Times'')]
*''[[E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump]]''
**A jury in New York awards [[E. Jean Carroll]] an $83.3 million defamation judgment against former [[President of the United States]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/01/26/trump-verdict-e-jean-carroll-defamation-trial/ (''The Washington Post'')]
